license: MIRAGE repo: NCBI public-domain notice; underlying BioASQ Task B data subject to BioASQ terms
split: MIRAGE BioASQ-Y/N: yes/no questions from BioASQ Task B gold test sets 2019-2023 (Tasks 7B-11B)
request_fields: question + options {A: yes, B: no} (MIRAGE removes the gold snippets)
notes: The BioASQ own release (participants-area.bioasq.org) requires creating an account, which this check does not do; the todo url_data is MIRAGE, so its redistributed BioASQ-Y/N subset was used (benchmark.json, key "bioasq"; the same file also holds medqa/medmcqa/pubmedqa/mmlu). 618 items match the MIRAGE README. Answers: 395 yes / 223 no. The MIRAGE repo also redistributes the raw BioASQ golden JSONs (rawdata/bioasq/Task7B-11B, with snippets); not downloaded. Other BioASQ task types (factoid, list, summary) are not in this version. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: Multiple choice: question, then options one per line with their source letters (A. yes / B. no).
